answer: Island-window challenge lottery. Each new identity must answer a live, per-agent challenge whose answer depends on a freshly sampled island of state, forcing the attacker to fetch and validate a full slice before replying. A public atlas records every issued challenge and its resolution latency. Responses arriving faster than the jetty threshold (the minimum plausible fetch time) are rejected as cloned. Cost per identity: one full state fetch plus a paid challenge slot, so N clones pay N times while yield stays flat.
